name: In Control
source: Step into the shoes of a new college student abroad and live the ultimate campus fantasy! Meet dozens of beautiful girls who are totally into you, flirt shamelessly, party until sunrise, and juggle friendships, rivalries, crushes, and forbidden romances like a true harem master. Live with a totally ordinary host family, explore every possible relationship path, create the perfect harem, make world-shaking choices that affect hearts, minds, and… other things! Every decision you make changes the world around you, every relationship escalates toward untold heights, and every heart you capture brings you closer to paradise… if you can stay in control. After all, in a world this perfect, what could possibly go wrong?
translation: 化身一名远赴异国求学的大学新生，尽情体验终极校园幻想吧！邂逅数十位对你倾心不已的绝色美女，肆无忌惮地调情撩妹、通宵狂欢直到日出，像真正的后宫大师一样在友情、竞争、暗恋与禁忌恋情之间游刃有余。住进看似再普通不过的寄宿家庭，探索每一条可能的感情路线，打造完美后宫，做出足以撼动世界、左右众人芳心与理智……乃至其他部位的重大抉择！你的每一个决定都会改变周遭的世界，每一段感情都会攀向难以言喻的高潮，而你俘获的每一颗芳心都将带你更接近极乐天堂……前提是你依然能牢牢掌控全局。毕竟，在这样一个完美无瑕的世界里，又怎么可能会出岔子呢？
